description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class named MatriculaController, which handles HTTP requests related to course registration (matricula). It manages registration actions such as saving a registration for a course, utilizing various service and repository classes.

classes.name: MatriculaController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing course registration actions, secured with role-based authorization.

methods.name: saveMatricula
methods.description: Handles GET requests to register a user for a course identified by 'id_curso'. It retrieves user details, creates a registration, and returns success or error views.
